window.new_comparison: Native coded strategy open to open+4h; all new entries before end. Oil is07-11UTC, unlike old inherited07-17UTC source/13-17 reporting boundary.
window.strict: Actual SL/TP exits inside four-hour observation window; surviving positions censored, never counted as losses or wins.
window.forced: Separate fresh quote at/after boundary within5s, existing broker bracket first; missing tail stays censored.
window.continuation: At most72 elapsed hours after fill using consecutive M30 bars from exactly window-end; stop at first missing bar, protected interval, ambiguous OHLC path or partial deadline bar. No holiday/weekend gap bridging; short ask uses disclosed frozen entry-spread proxy; financing remains unverified.

impulse.signal: Tier1 existing sigma-band marks. Tier2 symmetric fixed opening-mid band radius=max(abs(mid-open_mid)) over fresh quotes strictly within first30min, rounded to contract grid. Half-hour marks from30m through before4h; same fresh decision/next-later-quote within5s, executable bid beyond upper or ask below lower, full C<R durable cost veto before threshold and floor at decision/dispatch. One first admitted impulse only.
impulse.one_attempt: First admitted baseline impulse only; one entry maximum per arm/session. No retry or retune after macro rejection or no pullback.
impulse.open_mid: First fresh recorded bid/ask midpoint within5s of native session open. Native baseline sigma keeps original M30-bid opening reference for parity.
impulse.extreme: Freeze the midpoint at the baseline impulse dispatch/fill quote. No future maximum/minimum; no moving retracement target.
impulse.tier2_warning: Opening-range radius is a predeclared causal volatility proxy, not historical sigma; tiers are different hypotheses and never pooled.

pullback.entry: Origin+0.5*(frozen impulse midpoint-origin); buy level rounded down, sell rounded up to contract grid. First strictly later fresh executable ask<=buy level or bid>=sell level before window-end; fill at observed executable price, no unobserved limit fill. Queue availability remains unverified.
pullback.invalidation: Reject a first touch at or beyond the impulse origin, wrong impulse sign or invalid positive grid. Do not reinterpret an overshoot as an attractive entry.
pullback.risk: Same Phase2 structural stop, replacing24 by the registered admission reserve (24,2,3.74). Geometry changes by admission scenario; same-entry repricing at all3 costs holds geometry fixed.
pullback.floor: Registered28 or48bp applies to impulse R, not resized pullback R.

exit.state_machine: Reuse TwoStageReplay: old brackets first, entry-price amend on a strictly later valid quote, no partial exit or further trailing. Entry-price stop is not net breakeven.

macro_context.nature: Multi-day technical price-trend proxy only; no news, fundamental or institutional-flow evidence.
macro_context.drift: Last5 and20 completed coded sessions before this session open; net drift=last session final M30 close/oldest session first M30 open-1. All relevant bars must be present and closed before open. Both own drifts strictly align with impulse sign; zero does not confirm.
macro_context.peer: Same account and date, symmetric locked peer. If an eligible peer episode exists, require complete causal45-day peer context and neither5d nor20d drift opposing the impulse. Missing peer context blocks C. If no eligible same-date peer episode exists, permit with explicit peer_absent flag, per owner conditional rule.
macro_context.tier2: Fixed last5/20 coded-session endpoint drift: require oldest session first M30 open and most recent prior-session final M30 close, all causal before open. Interior gaps do not enter endpoint arithmetic; record them. No shorter-horizon fallback. Missing endpoints blocks C and is not a directional success. Same-date clean peer applies the same endpoint rule.

costs.spread: Actual bid/ask fills charge spread once; never deduct quoted spread again.
costs.benchmark: Join13 retained demo entry observations by account and symbol, reporting n and dates. Same-account median signed entry slippage with assumed2 or3.74bp exit sensitivity only; no other-account pooling, no default zero for missing entry benchmark.
costs.unknown: Round-trip slippage, commission, swap, conversion, queue and historical-contract terms remain unverified; omitted components mean partial-cost scenario, not actual net profit.
costs.admission_matrix: Explicit3 admission assumptions x2 thresholds x2 separate tiers; retain C<R. Therefore24bp normally excludes28–48bp risk. Reprice low-cost admitted paths at24bp to directly measure stress drag, with no silent gate removal.
